scientific_integrity: The constructive interval contraction is credited as an application of the motivating paper; the claimed contribution is the sharp graphwide necessity-and-sufficiency equivalence and its vertex-cover and complexity consequences. Finite exact checks do not replace infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected nondegenerate metric graphs with nonatomic full-support measures; circle handled separately. No classification for arbitrary infinite branched continua or prescribed dynamics. Independent review not yet performed.
title: Edge-hitting criterion and vertex-cover complexity of Milnor attractors on finite graphs
